title: Group
content: # **Objective** Understand the CLO-SET Group structure. Understanding the Group structure and operation is an initial step in collaborating with your team using CLO-SET. 1. What is a 'Group'? 2. Pricing Plan 3. Group Hierarchy 4. Permission 5. Company Transfer 6. Leave a Group # **Details** ### 1) What is a ‘Group’? ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 11.19.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776072787097) When a new user signs up in CLO-SET, a new Group is created. Group is the highest level Space in CLO-SET, and within each Group are Spaces such as Company - Brnad - Line - Season etc. You may invite other teammates to your Group, or be invited to another user's Group for collaboration. CLO-SET operates on a Group level. That is, Structure, Permission, and Pricing Plan is determined per Group. ### ### 2) Pricing Plan ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.42.04 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776054299033) CLO-SET Pricing Plan is applied to each Group. You may check which Plan the Group is using on your dashboard. Please check out our Pricing Page to learn about different options. ### 3) Group Hierarchy ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 1.47.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090181913) CLO-SET Group consists of different Spaces in a hierarchy. Within each Group can be multiple Company, Brand, Line, Season, Workroom, and Assortment Spaces. You may invite or share each Space with your teammates. Learn more about creating Spaces [here](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ### 4) Permission CLO-SET has a total of 5 Permission levels to provide for advanced security control options on your assets. Please check out this article to see different types of [Permissions](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Permission is also applicable to each Group. For example, you may be a Company Admin within 1 Group, but a Viewer on another Group. ### 5) Company Transfer * Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776081893657) Group Admin / Company Admin Company Transfer allows users to transfer Company between different Groups. This can be an alternative option when your Group Admin changed and you need to change the Group Admin to a different account. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.03.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776071175833) 1\. Go to 'Company Setting'. 2\. Click 'Company Transfer' and enter the Admin email of the recipient Group. 3\. Admin of the recipient Group must accept the request to complete the transfer. Log in to CLO-SET to accept. * * Please be noted that the RECIPIENT of the Company must be on Premium Plan. ### 6) Leave a Group * Permission: Company Admin / Collaborator / Editor / Viewer / Group Operator Members of the Group can choose to leave a Group without further actions from Admin. * Select the Group from the drop-down menu at the top left corner. * Go to 'Workspace' or 'Console' tab on the left. (Menu options may differ based on your permission) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776090704025) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776105889177) * Click 'Leave This Group' at the bottom. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106032153) * Confirm the action by clicking 'OK'. Make sure to check the name of the Group you are leaving. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776082826265) * Upon leaving the Group, Group Admin and Group Operator will receive notifications. *Group Admin cannot leave the Group. *Once you click 'OK', you may NOT undo the action. Please reach out to Group Admin to regain access. ### 🔔 Policy Update (2026.01.27) : Group Activation for New Users Joining via Invite or Share **New users** who sign up for CLO-SET **via a Group invitation or shared content** will have their personal Group **deactivated by default**. If needed, users can activate their own Group by selecting **Create My Group** from the Group Switcher. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54600755328793) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54606352390041)
content_description: This web page aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the CLO-SET Group structure, including its hierarchy, pricing plans, permissions, and collaboration features, to facilitate effective teamwork and user engagement.

title: Comment
content: # **Objective** Share your feedback with the team with CLO-SET Comment feature. 1. Creating Comment * Attach Images in Comment * AI Translator in Comments 2. Search Comment 3. Workroom & Assortment Comment 4. Web Tech Pack Comment 5. Permission 6. Notification # **Details** ### 1) Creating Comment ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 5.44.26 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356072985) **1\. Create Comment:** click ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356271257) icon from top-right corner, and start creating comments. You can tag individual user or [Teams](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303212732441) by using @ (ex. @clovirtualfashion). Maximum length is 3000 letters. *Please note that mentioning a non-member will automatically grant can View access. **2\. Create Editor:** You can edit the color, font, background color, or add emojis and attachments on the comment. Supported formats for attachments are: png, jpg, jpeg, pjpeg, gif, bmp. You may attach up to 25 files per Comment. Shortcut keys available on Edit Mode: * **Bold** : Ctrl (Cmd) + B * _Italic_ : Ctrl (Cmd) + I * Underline: Ctrl (Cmd) + U * @Mention: @ + name * Emoji 😊: [Window + . ] OR [Ctrl+Cmd+Space Bar] * In addition, bullet & numbering is also available as below. To add a bullet, add an asterisk (*) and hit space ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778356523801) **3\. View All**[**Versions**](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303241367961)**:** By default, you will comments on all Versions. Uncheck to only view the comments created on current Version. * ### Attach Images to your Comment (updated Feb 2024) 1. Drag & Drop Images from your local drive. 2. Preview Images before posting. 3. Availability to post Images only (without a text). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347736217) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778347989657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334192793) ---|---|--- * ### AI Translator in Comments CLO-SET now supports **AI-powered translation** in comments to improve cross-language collaboration. * Available in both **Space Comments** and **Content Comments** * Click **Translate** on a comment to view it in your preferred language This feature helps teams communicate more effectively across regions and languages without leaving the platform. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488326425) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53393488328985) ### 2) Search Comment * Search the comment you're looking for. Type in the keyword, and hit enter to view the results at the bottom. ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 5.55.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334395033) ### 3) Workroom & Assortment Comment * Commenting is also available at the [Workroom](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303190956697) and [Assortment](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168765593) level. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334541081) ### 4) Web Tech Pack Comment * Commenting is also available on all [Web Tech Pack](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) tabs. * Comments are created/saved separate on each Tab (Overview, BOM, Construction, Measurement, and Cost Estimation). * Under each Comment, you can find the version information of the uploaded file. * Please see below for details on Permissions (create, edit, and delete) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334743065) ### 5) Permission **Space** | **Action** | **Admin & Collaborator** | **Editor** | **Viewer** ---|---|---|---|--- **All** | **Create** | O | O | O **Workroom** **WTP** **Content** | **Edit** | * Group, Company Admin: O * Brand Admin, Collaborator: Limited* | Limited* **Delete** **Assortment** | **Edit** | * Admin: O * Collaborator: Limited* **Delete** **All** | **Mention others** | O | O | X *Can only Edit/Delete comments created by oneself, cannot modify comments created by other users. **Permission varies on Space Level. To start using Comment features, user must have permission to the applicable Space/Content. For example, if a user holds Content Editor permission, they can create new Comment on that Content, but may not be able to create Workroom Content. ### 6) Notification * When a Comment is created/edited/deleted, notification will be sent to the users with permission to the Workroom/Assortment/Content. * To stop receiving notifications, end users can turn off notification settings on specific Space or Content by unchecking the 'bell' button. * Notification of new Comments will be displayed on the Notifications tab. * Email Notification may be sent based on the end user's notification settings on 'My Page'. \- Depending on the notification settings, user can either receive all notifications or only those that are relevant. 1. 1. **All Comments** \- Continue to receive notifications for all comments. 2. **Mentioned Comments and Replies to My Comments Only** \- Receive notifications when mentioned \- Receive notifications when someone replies to the comment writer. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778334892825) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370438809) ---|--- > 💡 **Note:** The **"Changes on Comment"** notification options can be configured on the **My Page**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775456945689)
content_description: Enhance collaboration and communication within your team by utilizing the CLO-SET Comment feature to share feedback, attach images, and leverage AI translation tools.

title: Annotation
content: # **Objective** Create an Annotation for a detailed feedback. 1. Create/Edit Annotation 2. Annotation Shortcut 3. Download Annotations in PDF 4. Send Annotation by email 5. Copy Annotation to new Version # **Details** ### 1) Create Annotation To add an Annotation, click ![Icon Pack \(7\).png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417243673) icon in the upper right corner of 3D Viewer in Content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54366812407193) **1) Select a Version:** Annotation can be created on each Version. Once you're done, click 'Complete'. You will see a new Annotation has been created on the far right pane. * Annotation Toolbar ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778432888217) | Comment (T) | Click within the 3D viewer, write a comment, and click ‘POST’. Double-click to edit. Shortcuts: **Bold (Ctrl + B)** / _Italic (Ctrl + I)_ /Underline (Ctrl + U) ---|---|--- Image (I) | You can attach an image file as annotation. Select (V) | You can change the position of comment or drawing. Pencil (B) Line (L) Pen (P) Arrow (A) Arc (C) Rentangle (R) | Create drawing and basic figures. Line Color (O) Line Width (W) | You can set drawing color and thickness. ### 2) Annotation Shortcut All Functions | Copy | Ctrl + C ---|---|--- Paste | Ctrl + V Flip Horizontally | Shift + H Flip Vertically | Shift + V ![Annotation.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778417947417) ### 3) Download Annotation in PDF ![Screenshot 2023-11-08 at 6.29.00 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778418213785) Click on the Annotation icon on your right pane to view the list of Annotations. title: Account Deletion & Subscription Cancellation
content:
**Q1 : How do I delete my account?** **A1 : There are two ways to delete your CLO-SET account.** You can either wait until your current subscription expires and then delete your account, or choose to cancel your subscription immediately and delete your account right away. **Note:** Once your account is deleted, all data will be permanently removed and cannot be recovered. * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to delete account on CLO-SET. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## **Details** #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1. Visit “My Page” from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) to start the account deletion process. ![mceclip1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461458073) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "My Page". ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454111769) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![mceclip4.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454112281) > 💡 **Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller
> > on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete
> > the account directly. Please click **"Contact US"** button for further assistance. ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461460761) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. > 💡 **Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active only **after the end date**. #### ![mceclip6.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134454119193) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ > 💡 **Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. Make sure to review carefully before continuing. ![mceclip7.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461463705) 2\. Account will be deleted immediately after email verification and a short survey are completed. ![mceclip8.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461466521)![mceclip9.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54134461468185) * * * **Important Notes on Account Deletion** 1) Once deleted, the account cannot be recovered, and sign-in will no longer be possible on both the website and software. 2) After deletion, content and posts previously created will display the user name as follows: * If the email address is shown: **“Deleted Account”** will be displayed instead. * If the account name is shown: it will remain as **{account name}** , as in the case of CLO-SET. *
content_description: This web page provides clear instructions on how to delete your CLO-SET account, either after your subscription expires or immediately, along with important notes regarding data loss and recovery.

title: Didn’t receive the verification email during sign-up?
content: **Q1: I am not receiving the verification email. What should I do?** **A1:** Double check the email address typed in. Make sure you do not have typos. **A2:** If you are using your company email, please contact your IT team for any firewall setups. The verification email may be blocked from your company's email server settings, even before reaching your spam inbox. **A3:** If you are still experiencing the issue, please [submit a request](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new) for a manual verification process. **A4: Student Email** \- Some school domains block external emails. Please check if your school domain is connected to the verification email on [Verify Email Address Link](https://www.verifyemailaddress.org/). If you see the result as "Connecting did not work", please ask your school admin (especially the technical division) to check if you could receive the verification email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com) **A5: Gmail Account -** Mark incorrectly classified emails as Not spam. Go to your spam folder and open the email from [noreply@clo-set.com](mailto:noreply@clo-set.com). Click on the 'Report not spam' button at the top. Gmail uses machine learning to recognize spam. So you need to mark CLO-SET emails as not spam manually to let Gmail learn your behavior. **Note :** Even if your email address has not been verified yet, you can still log in to CLO-SET. After logging in, you can complete the email verification process at any time again. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138028055193) * * * **Q2: I signed up using a Google account and did not see an email verification step. Is this an issue?** **A1:** No, this is not an issue. If you sign up using a Google account, your email address is automatically verified, so no additional email verification step is required. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54138106505369)
content_description: This webpage provides troubleshooting steps for users experiencing issues with email verification, ensuring a smooth registration process on CLO-SET.

title: How do I change my email address?
content: ## **Q1 : How can I change my email address?** **A1 :** Go to **My Page** and click **Change Email** to update your email address. * * * **Q2 : I see a message saying that my email cannot be changed. Why is this happening?** **A2 :** There may be several reasons why you are unable to change your email address. Your issue may fall under one of the cases below. 1. **Email address already in use** 2. **Unable to change email** 3. **Account region mismatch** (*CLO / CLO-SET only) 4. **Email change will affect the plan type** (*CLO only) For detailed explanations and step-by-step solutions, please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) . * * * ## **Objective** Understand how to change your email address, and the following implications of changing your account email. 1. [Change Email vs. Email Switching](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QNCTQSZMYFJFQ43ZPVV7T3) 2. [Ground Rules for Change Email](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#01J14B22H7ABR174MHJYQN61F6) 3. [Change Email Guide](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN98R7YZPTP1RMBQ3QSFP) * General Flow * Confirm License Info * Troubleshooting 4. [Change Email Implications](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303201935897-Change-Email-from-CLO-SET#h_01J0QPN6FK48VSWVVB87JZJ82Y) 5. [Troubleshooting](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ## **Details** #### **1) Change Email vs. Email Switching** **Change Email** | **VS** | **Email Switch** **(when the 'new email' is already on CLO-SET)** ---|---|--- ![change email.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774805401) | ![emai switch.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773992217) * **Change Email** : Change your CLO-SET Integrated account email. Changing the CLO-SET email will also update the connected CLO & Marvelous Designer license information if any. Please find instructions below on the [Change Email Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577). * **Email Switch** : Email Switching is for users hoping to connect their existing CLO or Marvelous Designer license with a different CLO-SET email account. This feature is not available yet. For such requests, please [submit a ticket](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143). #### **2) Ground Rules for Change Email** * Your CONNECT account is the same as CLO-SET account. The two services share account information. * Accounts registered as Enterprise or Academic on CLO software cannot use 'Change email' feature. * If the email address you want to change TO is already registered in CLO-SET, you cannot override an existing account. Please refer to the [troubleshooting guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for further steps. #### **3) Change Email Guide** 1\. Visit 'my page' from [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) , [**CLO**](https://clo3d.com/accounts), or [**Marvelous Designer**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account) to start the change email process ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773993625) 2\. If your CLO-SET account is also active on CLO or Marvelous Designer service, please note that the account information on respective services will also be updated. Click 'OK' to proceed. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773994393) 3\. On the following screen, please type in the new email address to be used. Click 'Send' to receive an email with the verification code. [Not receiving verification emails?](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261750460569) 4\. Once the verification is complete, you will see the final modal on the right. Please go back to the sign-in page, and start signing in with the new email address. Please also carefully read the implications of changing your emails. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773995545) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139773997977) 5\. **[Important]** Active License found under your New Email Address If the there is/are active CLO or Marvelous Designer license under the 'new email' you typed in, your CLO-SET account will now be integrated with those License information. One of the two modals below will be displayed with the list of Licenses to be connected. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774811289)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774003737)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004121)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774004377) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54139774006937) *Signing again with your current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)) will create a 2nd CLO-SET account after changing your account email to [newemail@clo3d.com](mailto:newemail@clo3d.com). *If you would like to keep the license under the current email ([abc@clo3d.com](mailto:abc@clo3d.com)), please use the '[Email Switching](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749831577)' feature instead. 6\. Troubleshooting Should you experience an error while attempting to change the email address, please find the [Troubleshooting Guide](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) for instructions. Note : #### **4) Change Email Implications** * **Impact on Request and Community History** Changing your email address will disconnect the history of your requests and community activities. This includes comments, request history, and other related data, which will no longer be associated with your new email address. * **Account Type** Enterprise user email changes are not allowed. Please make the change through your Company ID. It is possible to change your personal email to a corporate email, but the account type will not change. If you wish to change your account type from personal to enterprise, please contact our support team. * Additionally, please review what to consider when changing emails for each product: [CLO](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [Marvelous Designer](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CONNECT](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) / [CLO-SET](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) ### [CLO] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **Plan Type Considerations** If you have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), you won't be able to proceed with the email change. You may need to retain your current email or consider cancelling your subscription to initiate the change. If you don't have an active license and changing your email address affects your plan type (e.g., student to individual or vice versa), your user type will automatically change with the email change. (Individual↔️Student) However, be aware that this may impact the available subscription plans. Only plans corresponding to your updated user type will be available for purchase. * **Change Email between CLO global and China Websites** When you change your email on the CLO Global website, you cannot change it to the email registered on the CLO China website. ### [Marvelous Designer] * **Billing Email Matching** If your billing email matches your CLO-SET account email, it will automatically update when you change your CLO-SET email. However, if they don't match, your billing email will remain unchanged. * **License** Changing your email does not affect your license. You can change your email even if you have an active license, and you will be able to continue using your license with the new email. ### [CLO-SET / CONNECT] * **Billing Email Matching** The registered payment information on Stripe will NOT be updated automatically. To change the email address of your Stripe account, please visit Stripe (<https://stripe.com/>). * **Account Data** Users can continue accessing the Groups and uploaded files they have permission to. Please note that your account name will not be updated. To change your account name, please visit [https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount.](https://style.clo-set.com/account/myaccount) #### **5) Troubleshooting** For various reasons, email changing is not supported systematically for certain accounts. Please follow the [**Troubleshooting Guide**](https://clovf-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45261749919129) to reach the support team. * * * Before changing your email address in CLO-SET, please consider these factors to ensure a smooth transition and avoid any unexpected issues. If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to [Contact Us](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/requests/new?ticket_form_id=9530590112143).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on how to change your email address in CLO-SET, along with the implications and troubleshooting steps for common issues encountered during the process.

title: Invite/Share
content: Invite your team members, or share your work to your partners. Understand the difference and learn how to start collaborating. # **Objective** 1. Invite vs. Share 2. Invite 3. Share 4. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2\. Select permission (Admin/Collaborator) 3\. Click 'Invite' ---|--- #### ***[Changes on Invite]** **From May 2024** | **Prior to May 2024** ---|--- Recipient is added to the Group and granted access automatically, and do NOT need to accept the invite. | Recipient must first accept the invite to access the Space. ### 3) Share * ### Share Workroom / Assortment / Content ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.46.51 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776106958489) Editors or above can share Workroom/Assortment/Content with others. From Content page, click on 'Share' tab on your far right. From Workroom/Assortment, use the right pane. ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.49.48 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776139682073) | 1\. Enter the email address of the user you wish to invite 2\. Select permission (Can Edit/Can View) 3\. (optional) For Viewers, you may add download/upload permission 4\. Click 'Share' *Please be cautious when sharing your Content. ---|--- ### ### **📝** Share with Link Policy update Update (December 2025) The **Enable Download** option has been updated. * **Share with Link remains available** , and **guests can still view content** as before. * **Downloads are limited to group members only**. * Even if **Enable Download** is enabled, **non–group members can view content but cannot download.** ### 4) Accessible People ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 3.56.54 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776092477721) | | • At the bottom of the Share Tab, you may view the full list of Accessible People to each Space/Content. • This includes not only the people shown on the above list, but all users who with access. *For example, from Workroom, you can only invite Editor/Viewers, but anyone with Admin/Collaborator permission on the upper level Spaces can also access the Workroom. ---|---|--- ### 5) Public Content You may publicize your Content to share with a broader audience. Find out more details on Permission Management [HERE](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303195393049). ![Screenshot 2023-08-16 at 5.29.18 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776107853849)

title: AI Studio - Graphic Generator
content: # **Objective** ### Understand how to use the **AI Studio - Graphic Generator** on CLO-SET. 1. ##### What is AI STUIDO - Graphic Generator 2. ##### How to Use the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET # **Details** ### 1) What is AI Studio - Graphic Generator? AI Studio – Graphic Generator generates customizable graphic images from text-based prompts. By simply typing in keywords (or uploading image), you can create unique graphics that can be applied directly to your 3D garments and patterns. #### **[Generate]** 1. You can choose either the **Text** or **Image** option in the AI Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784829209) 2. Set options, enter prompts (or upload image), and click the Generate button.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777066777) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784841113) **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Content Type** | Select the type of content. Generate embroidery graphics from simple keyword prompts, or instantly transform uploaded images into embroidery-style visuals. **Transparent Background** | Apply a transparent background to the image.**This option is not available for the Pop Art type.** **Text Prompt** | Enter the prompts. **✨ Writing Tips:** * **List the words.** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. * **Emphasize certain words more.** If parentheses are used in the word you want to emphasize, it takes up more weight.Parentheses on certain words take more weight. Weight increase rate : (word) 1.1 times, ((word)) 1.21 times. **![Frame 247.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784844825)** **Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Graphic image is created newly each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as possible. It may differ from the existing results depending on the addition or change of the prompts. **Random** | The sample prompt is randomly applied. #### **[Apply]** 1. Click the Apply button below when the AI Texture is completely generated. → If you apply it, the result will be uploaded as a **new version**. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946777077785) ##### **📝Note:** It may take a while to create when there are many users at the same time. ### 2) Using the Graphic Generator in CLO-SET 1. Upload content from AI Studio Click the __**New**__**** button in the workroom and select __**Upload from AI Studio**__. Image content can be generated instantly using the**Graphic Generator** within the workroom space. ![Group 1050.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52946784853273) 2. AI Studio in Blank Content In the workroom, click the __**New**__ button and select __**Create Blank Content**__. After choosing a content type, click the __**Try Uploading from AI Studio**__ button on the blank content page to instantly generate image content using the Graphic Generator.![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52948952725529)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568312601) 3. Version Upload with AI Studio _**Version upload**_ can also be performed using __**AI Studio Graphic Generator**__ when uploading a new version within the content page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52997568316697) **📝Note:** The AI Studio Graphic Generator feature is available only on paid plans. AI Studio for CLO-SET Enterprise is not yet available. ####
content_description: Explore the AI Studio - Graphic Generator on CLO-SET to effortlessly create and customize unique graphic images from text prompts or uploaded images for your 3D garments and patterns.

title: Render
content: # **Objective** You can render the images on the 3D Viewer in the content page. Check real-time rendering progress and download the rendered file by clicking ![mceclip3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778675651993) icon on the Content page. * Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) 1. Render - How To 2. Crop Option in Render Setting 3. Rendering Server Status 4. Render Preset 5. Render in CLO vs CLO-SET # **Details** ### • Update in Render Settings (Feb 2024) The **default** **background setting** has been updated to match your Render Settings in CLO3D. You may choose to disable the option to customize the Render background in CLO-SET. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778722895257) ### 1) Render - How To ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778692305689) 1\. Click ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676417177) (Render) icon on the left pane of the Content page. 2\. It will lead you to 'Rendering Settings' where you can set the Colorway, Type, Image Size, Background, and Quality of rendered images. 3\. After the setting, click 'Render' button to start rendering. *Please note that the maximum image size is 5000px. *For Turntable images, maximum image count on CLO-SET is 64. ## ### 2) Crop Option in Rendering Setting * crops to the nearest 5 pixels of the 3D content,_regardless of what is shown in the 3D Viewer_ * works both in transparent and colored background * Style Page > Render > Rendering Settings > Background > Crop * You must uncheck the 'Use Software settings' before applying the Crop option ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778676720025) In order to properly use the 'Crop' option, **the 3D content needs to be placed within the darkened frame shown inside the 3D Viewer.** ![crop.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778739645465) Although the darkened frame does not reflect the cropped frame when the Crop option in clicked, _the 3D content is first cropped by the darkened frame_. Thus, if the 3D Content sits outside of the darkened frame, the render will be cropped. For example, if the render is triggered as shown below on the left, the result will be as the following on the right. ![Screenshot_2023-01-27_at_9.15.27_AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778709349145) | ► | ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778724565657) ---|---|--- Final Render output shown below. ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694043673) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_3.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778740992665) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778678578073) ![Reflective_Jogger_and_Crop_Top_Closet_Library_Fabric__Colorway_A_1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778694926361) ### 3) Rendering Server Status 'CLO-SET Rendering Server Status' is a feature that allows users to be more aware of their rendering status with the information of server status and their current orders in the rendering queues. Find out more details on [THIS ARTICLE](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303263040921). ### 4) Render Preset For a unified Render output, you may upload a Render Preset for your Company members. Find out more [here](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129). ### 5) Render in CLO vs CLO-SET Basically, V-Ray's CPU and GPU rendering don't produce identical results. CLO and CLO-SET both use [Vray Rendering.](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/115003861567-V-Ray-Render) However, CLO-SET only supports GPU rendering, whereas CLO supports both GPU and CPU rendering. The results of the GPU render of CLO and the render of CLO-SET are consistent. But, as CPU and GPU rendering results differ, you cannot expect to see the same results between the CLO CPU and CLO-SET GPU rendering results. We suggest the following workflow. Select the device before starting the rendering task and generate the final output. Choose either one of the workflow. > Utilizing GPU rendering in CLO and CLO-SET. > Utilizing CPU rendering in CLO. Unfortunately, attempting to synchronize the CPU and GPU is impossible.
content_description: This webpage provides instructions for rendering images in the 3D Viewer, including updates on render settings, cropping options, server status, and differences between CLO and CLO-SET rendering.

title: Permission
content: # **Objective** **![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.27.55 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777847835289)**| ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.28.05 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777868204185) ---|--- **The following is the permission hierarchy of CLO-SET.** Users can be given any one of the following access rights, in descending order of access: 1. Admin & Collaborator 2. Editor & Viewer 3. Group Operator 4. Updates on Editor/Viewer (Dec 2023) 5. [**Setup Guide** ](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777833207321)\- find PDF guide at the end of the article To view permission by space and functionality, please refer to Permission Table by Space # **Details** ### 1) Admin & Collaborator ![Screenshot 2024-01-16 at 2.40.00 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777848354585) **Permission** | **Admin** | **Collaborator** ---|---|--- **Space** | Group, Company, Brand | Company, Brand **Granted by** | Invited by Admin **Access** | Can create/edit/delete Spaces & Styles. Can invite Collaborators and share to Editors/Viewers. | Can **ONLY** create/edit/delete Season(Line) and below. Can share the workroom & Company Library to Editors/Viewers. **Description** | * Group Admin: All access. Can create/edit/delete all Spaces and invite users to any level of Space. Subject to payment for the entire Group. * Company Admin: Can create/edit/delete Company and below. Invite users to the Company. * Brand Admin: Can create/edit/delete Brand and below. Invite users to the Brand. | * Company Collaborator: Can access all features for Company and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete/share Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. * Brand Collaborator: Can access all features for Brand and below. But can ONLY create/edit/delete Season (Line) and below. Can share Company Library, Workroom and below. > 💡 **Note:** In the group hierarchy, only one group admin is allowed. ### 2) Editor & Viewer ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777868985881) **Permission** | **Editor** | **Viewer** ---|---|--- **Space** | Workroom, Assortment, Style (Content) **Granted by** | Shared by Admin/Collaborator/Editor **Access** | Have authority to edit and share Workroom/Assortment/Style that they are shared to. | Can only view the Workroom/Assortment/Style that has been shared. Group members can select to grant download/upload options to Viewers when sharing Workroom/Style. **Description** | | ![Screen_Shot_2022-12-04_at_10.10.56_PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777858259865) * Enable Download: With the download option, Viewers can download files, tech packs, and rendering images. * Enable Upload: With the upload option, Viewers can upload 3D assets and attachments to Workroom/Style. Check out the below article for details on this new feature. [https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/5111216531087-New-Feature-CLO-SET-Viewer-Upload-Option-](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303268953113) ### 3) Group Operator * **Group Operators can only access the Admin Console. In the Admin Console, one can access billing information, user statistics, group settings, and developer page. title: Content Copy
content: # **Objective** You can copy a Content to a different Workroom, or within the same Workroom. When Contents are copied, it will bring with it all of the details within. 1. Content Copy 2. Copy Type 3. Copy as Linked Content # # **Details** ### 1) Content Copy * Enter the Workroom in which the desired Content is located. * Select the Content * Select 'Copy' from the floating menu![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778918990489) * Enter the name of the Copy * Select Copy Type, and select the Workroom to generate the Copy in * To make it a Linked Content, turn on the option ### 2)Copy Type ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50931188948889) ---|--- 1. Only Content : Only the selected content file will be copied 2. Copy with Comments/Annotations : The content file along with its comments and annotations will be copied. 3. Copy with Web Tech Pack : The web tech pack data will be copied together. (Comments in the WTP will be copied, but the basic comments and annotations will not be copied.) ### ### 3)Copy as Linked Content ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778919242905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50944982965529) ---|--- 1. Turn on 'Make a Child Content' option 2. Enter a Memo about the Child Content, and click 'OK' 3. Your will see a Child Content has been created at the selected Workroom 4. If not, it will be reset. *When you multi-copy and create Child Content, each copy will be linked to the same garment only. For example, if you select garment A,B,C and copy them with Child Content option, _garment A_ will be linked to the _copy of garment A_ only.

Users who have been deleted from the Group and no longer have permission will be greyed out. 5. Click on the field to sort - either in ascending or descending order ### 2) Content ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 5.01.22 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951263897) * Filter the Date & Workroom you want to view * For Group Operators, the 'Space' filter will only display the list of Spaces to which they have Viewer or above permission to. Group Admin can select any Space within the Group. * Total Style Contents: Total number of Contents uploaded during the date range, and included in the statistics shown below. This covers ONLY the Contents you have viewing permission to. * Average Used Colors: Average number of Colors used per Style Content * Total Fabric Colors: Total number of Fabric Color used within the selected Space *ONLY Applicable to any Content uploaded on March, 2023 and onward. #### **1\. Total Color Composition Rate** ![Total_Color_Composition_Rate.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778951412633) The Doughnut Chart on the left shows the distribution of Primary Colors used for the Style Contents. Hover over the Color to view the details. On the right hand table, click on each Primary Color to view all the related Original Colors. * Primary Color: Main Color(Hex/Pantone) with the highest usage rate among similar color group * Original Color: All unique Colors used. Grouped by Primary Color. *Color usage rate is calculated based on the fabric size #### **2\. Trends Chart**![Period](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778983106073) Trends Chart shows the number of Style Content that used the top 10 Primary Colors over time. You may view the Color Trend chronically. Change the chart type to _Bar or Line_ , or change period to _Week or Year_ to change the view. Bar Chart ![BarChart.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938710041) | Line Chart ![ColorTrend.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778938989849) ---|--- #### #### **3\. Scatter Chart** ![Color](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778939302809) Scatter Chart visualizes the Saturation/Brightness of the Colors used. Click on the Primary Color to view the Original Colors included in the group. * **X-axis** : Hue (Color Spectrum of 0~360) * **Y-axis** : Saturation or Brightness per your selection. Click on the upper left dropdown button to switch the view. * **Marker Size:** Number of Style Contents that used the selected Color. ### 3) Leadtime ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50834306994073)Leadtime Analysis shows the workflow efficiency with a clear **summary of lead times** , **completion trends** , and the **current status of all contents** in their Workroom. 1. Summary : Displays the total content and overall lead time at the top. * Total Style Content : The total amount of style content in the space (or selected space) 2. Average Leadtime : Displays the average time it takes for content to move through each workflow step, based on the applied filters. 3. Average Spent time : Displays the average time spent at each workflow step for the filtered contents in a Space. 4. Style List : Lists the current lead times for all Style contents in the Workroom. 5. Export : Lead time analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123313998745) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) ---|--- Visit Leadtime menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' and 'category' to see the analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._** ### 4) Cost Saving ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123610837785) Cost Saving Analysis shows the**potential sample cost savings** across all Style contents in Workrooms. The savings are calculated based on the **number of versions** and **colorways per style** , multiplied by a **sampling cost** defined by the user. 1. Summary : Displays the total styles, colorways, default sample cost and total saving cost at the top. * Total Style : Total number of contents with ‘Style’ content type. * Total Colorway : Total number of digital sample versions created across styles. * Default Sample Cost : Default sampling cost to estimate the total saving cost. * Total Saving Cost : Sum of estimated savings across all styles, calculated by: Total Colorways × Sampling Cost (per style) 2. Colorways per workflow : Displays the total number of colorways at each workflow status. 3. Sample Saving Cost per Content : Displays Each style’s saving is calculated as: colrway x Sampling Cost (per style) 4. Export : Cost saving analysis data on the screen can be exported to PDF. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314013849) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314002201) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314005657) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/50123314015769) ---|---|--- Visit Cost Saving Analysis menu of Data Intelligence, select the 'space' , 'category' and 'workflow' to see the cost analysis. * The Space option is only visible when a user with admin permission accesses the Admin Console. * The analysis data is updated and displayed based on the previous day. > **_Items uploaded after April 2025 with no workflow status changes may be excluded from the list._**

title: Change Plan / Unsubscribe
content: # **Objective** Learn how to cancel your Advanced Plan subscription and downgrade to free plan. 1. Change Plan * Upgrade * Downgrade (Unsubscribe) 2. Refund Policy *Before you start: Plan type can only be managed by[ Group Admin or Group Operator](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303153376537). Changing your plan type will affect everyone in your [Group](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). # **Details** ### 1) Change Plan * To change your plan type, visit [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721). * Make sure you are in the correct Group. Check the Group name on the top-left corner of your screen. To switch Groups, click on the downward arrow (⌄) next to the Group name. * Click 'Change Plan' on the right to select a new plan. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328362905) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778328565657) ---|--- ### ⬆️ Upgrade Upgrading will take place **immediately** after the payment is made. 1\. Upgrading from **Standard to Premium** * * Your remaining measurement period for the Standard plan will be refunded in credit form, to be applied automatically for your new Premium plan subscription. * Example) Billing changes when upgrading from Standard to Premium ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778314053401) 1\. Once the upgrading is initiated, your Standard plan subscription will be cancelled. If you had any remaining days under the Standard plan, the unused days will be refunded in the form of credit. * * * In this example, $92.80 has been refunded (for the unused 28 days, for 5 users). This resulted in a total credit balance of $54.24 based on previous bill history (which means that the previous credit balance was -$38.56) 2\. Premium plan subscription created immediately. * * * A new bill is created for 5 users with a charge of $200 ($40 x 5). This resulted in a total credit balance of -$145.76 ($54.24 - $200.00). Negative credit indicates that the user owes the amount to be paid. 3\. Payment completed, and Premium plan subscription started. 2\. Upgrading from **Free to paid plans** (Standard or Premium) * From [Console - Summary](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303236765721), click on 'Subscribe' ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329034265) * From the [CLO-SET Pricing](https://style.clo-set.com/service/pricing) page, select a plan to subscribe, and follow the [payment process.](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171146009) ### ⬇️ Downgrade (Unsubscribe) Downgrading will take place on your Group's **next renewal date**. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. 1\. Downgrading from **Premium to Standard** * Important: Once your Group is downgraded to the Standard plan, there will be restrictions on the Group's usage. Please make sure to review the restrictions to minimize disruption. * Your existing Premium plan subscription will be valid until the end of your measurement period. On your next renewal date, your plan will be changed to Standard. * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Standard plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329183129) | ![Pricing Page Modal.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329308313) ---|--- 2\. Downgrading from **Premium/Standard to Free** * Downgrading will take place on your Group's next renewal date. Please note that CLO-SET does not refund the unused days of your monthly subscription once it is initiated. * If you had pending**negative credit balance** (to be paid) at the point of downgrading, you will be charged for the amount before your subscription is cancelled. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778329438361) * If you had pending**positive credit balance** at the point of downgrading, or failure of repurchasing, your credit will be 0 upon downgrading to free, and a billing history entry will be created. * For accounts that have already downgraded to Free before August 12, 2025, any existing positive credit will not be removed and remain) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778302557849) * You **CANNOT** downgrade if your current usage exceeds the plan limit of the Free plan. Please review your usage on '[Console - Billing - Usage History](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239183257)' and make changes accordingly. ### 2) Refund Policy * Your subscription is valid until the end of Measurement Period, unless there was an upgrade attempt. * Please note that under [CLO-SET TOS](https://style.clo-set.com/policy/terms-of-service), no refunds are made for unused number of days in cash form, unless required by law. * For any inquiries, please [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new).

Both the 2D/3D POM data is exported from your .zprj / .zpac file * Select Measurement Unit: Inch / cm / mm ---|--- ### 4) Version When you upload a new version of the Content, information on Measurement tab is also updated. To view the older Version, you may select from the drop-down menu. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 11.23.10 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778473826329) * ### 5) Create Blank POM **1) When the content is blank** * In **WTP → Measurement** tab, a guide message appears: **“Create Draft POM.”** ![Group 1005.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607142169) * Click the button to generate a **blank Measurement Table**. ![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) * Click the button to generate a **blank Measurement Table**. ![Group 1007.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607157401) * Double-click each column to enter data: **POM, Description, HTMComment, Tolerance, Target**. * Right-click a **row** to open the context menu and **Add Row / Delete Row**. * Right-click a **Size** **column** to open the context menu and **Add Column / Set Base / Delete Column**. * **Note:** For blank content, the **3D viewer is not available**. **2) When the content has no Measurement Data** * In **WTP → Measurement** tab, the guide message **“Create Draft POM”** appears. ![Group 1008.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782607159961) * Click the button to generate a**Measurement Table**. ![Group 1009.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579110681) * Double-click each column to enter data: **POM, Description, HTMComment, Tolerance, Target**. ![Group 1012.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/49782579117849) * If the file is a **3D file** , the **3D viewer** appears on the **left**. * Right-click a **row** to open the context Version updates follow the same rules as the **BOM** table: * The update is based on the **latest WTP file**. * **Items added** in the **previous version** are **carried over** to the new version. * Carried-over items are **listed at the bottom** of the table. * **Duplicate entries cannot be automatically distinguished**. * After the version update, **editing the previous version is disabled**.
